package main import ( "context" "fmt" "github.com/vuka-lang/ui/v2" ) // Table pages through its rows, keeping the page and sort in the URL. type Table[T any] struct { Title string Rows []T Sort string @ui.URL("sort") page int @ui.URL("page").Default(1) shown int label string } @ui.Mount func (t *Table[T]) mount(ctx context.Context) error { t.shown = len(t.Rows) return nil } @ui.OnChange func (t *Table[T]) changed(ctx context.Context) error { t.label = fmt.Sprint(t.Sort) return nil } func (t *Table[T]) Next() { t.page++ }

{Title}: {shown} rows, page {page}, sort {Sort}
